description.narrative:
This program aims to reduce maternal deaths and unintended teenage pregnancies in the districts of Mayuge and Kamuli (impact) by increasing the utilization of integrated SRHR services by adolescents and young people in Eastern Uganda. The program targets to reach 278,062 young people between the ages of 10 and 24 and 276,533 beneficiaries above the age of 25. 1. Empower adolescents and young people aged 10-24, including those in hard-to-reach communities and those most at risk, to decide over their own bodies, make informed choices, and utilize high quality, integrated SRHR information and services (individual level)
2. Increase capacity of health facilities in the target districts to provide universal access to acceptable high quality integrated SRHR and GBV services, particularly for the most vulnerable adolescents and youth (service delivery level) .
3. Enhance and optimize the enabling environment at the sub-national and national level (community, district and national level) for adolescents and young people to exercise their SRH rights, make informed choices, and demand SRH services (eco-system level) and to hold leaders accountable.
